name: skill-mcp
description: Cloud Skill File System & MCP Permission Gateway

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m 'chore(release): v%s' && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m 'chore(release): v%s' && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m 'chore(release): v%s' && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:alpha: npm version prerelease --preid=alpha -m 'chore(release): v%s' && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:beta: npm version prerelease --preid=beta -m 'chore(release): v%s' && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:rc: npm version prerelease --preid=rc -m 'chore(release): v%s' && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:dev: npm version prerelease --preid=dev -m 'chore(release): v%s' && git push --follow-tags
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test
